title: references_ui edge is authoritative; ui_refs is a derived cache
context: Alternative approaches: use ui_refs as the source of truth and derive the edge; allow both to be edited and reconcile them; use neither.
decision: The `references_ui` edge is the authoritative source of truth. The `ui_refs` field on a module node is a derived cache, written by Schematify on every edge change and never hand-edited. The linter reports a mismatch as an error.
consequences: One source of truth for module-screen relationships; edge creation automatically updates the cache; consistency is enforced; hand-editing ui_refs becomes an error, not a feature.
